How the voice handoff works

The watch stays lightweight while the existing Codex session remains on the Mac.

Apple Watch→Captures the question and shows short replies.
iPhone→Transcribes voice and securely routes the message.
DoneSure→Adds the task ID and recent task context.
Codex on Mac→Receives the prompt in the existing thread and responds.
Apple Watch✓Delivers a concise reply with a haptic tap.
